Healthcare Influencers in Nepal

Wellness and mental-health awareness content has grown steadily on Nepali social media. Kolab connects clinics, health brands, and wellness businesses with creators covering that space responsibly.

Why health and wellness brands in Nepal work with creators

As conversations around mental health, general wellness, and preventive care have opened up in Nepal, a growing group of creators has built audiences around approachable, non-clinical health content — a tone traditional healthcare advertising often misses.

Kolab connects clinics, wellness centers, and health-product brands with those creators, so a wellness campaign reaches an audience that already engages with the topic.

What healthcare and wellness creators cover on Kolab

Wellness creators on Kolab post general health tips, mental-health awareness content, and product or service reviews across Instagram and YouTube, most closely matched under Fitness & Health and Lifestyle.

A clinic or wellness brand can post a paid awareness campaign, or offer a free open event around a service trial in exchange for honest coverage.

How it works

  • Create a business account on Kolab and post a paid campaign or a free open event.
  • Set your category, platform, budget or offer, and target healthcare influencers anywhere in Nepal.
  • Browse creator profiles directly, or review the proposals creators submit to your campaign.
  • Message shortlisted creators in-app to align on the brief, deliverables, and timeline.
  • Approve the finished content and release payment through Kolab’s escrow-protected system.
  • Leave a review once the collaboration wraps up, building a track record for future campaigns.

Verified, safe collaborations

Health-related content carries extra responsibility, and Kolab's creator verification and escrow-protected payments apply the same way here as in every category — identity checked, budgets held until approved work is delivered.
